source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.short_quote: six signs, or a hundred and eighty degrees; four signs, or a hundred and twenty degrees; three signs, or ninety degrees; and two signs, or sixty degrees

calculation_dependencies: zodiacal distance in signs and degrees
normalized_rule: Classify the four mutual zodiacal configurations by their source distances: opposition at six signs or 180 degrees, trine at four signs or 120 degrees, quartile at three signs or 90 degrees, and sextile at two signs or 60 degrees.
synthesis_notes: This is the parent source-specific distance taxonomy, not four separate aspect outcomes or a scientific compatibility claim.
review_notes: This is the parent taxonomy for the four source distances. The specialized harmonious/discordant rules add separate Chapter XVI labels; later minor aspects and editorial mundane-aspect discussion are not imported.
transmission_notes: The four distances are in the Ashmand/Proclus main text. The surrounding footnote discusses later editorial objections and minor aspects; those are deliberately not treated as part of this source-specific taxonomy.
